import sys
from collections import Counter

table = bytes(i + 32 if 65 <= i <= 90 else (i if 97 <= i <= 122 else 32) for i in range(256))
counts = Counter()
buf = sys.stdin.buffer
 read = buf.read
rem = b""
while True:
    chunk = read(4 * 1024 * 1024)
    if not chunk:
        break
    chunk = (rem + chunk).translate(table)
     idx = chunk.rfind(b" ")
    if idx == -1:
        rem = chunk
    else:
        counts.update(chunk[:idx].split())
        rem = chunk[idx+1:]
if rem:
    counts.update(rem.split())
top10 = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[:10]
for w, c in top10:
    print(f"{w.decode()} {c}")
